previous.description: MCP server for ZStudio EIS (electrochemical impedance spectroscopy). Ties ZStudio's validation / DRT / fitting engine into a conversational analysis flow — check data quality faster, compare physically plausible candidate models, and understand the limits of every result; every number is computed by the verified ZStudio engine, with the AI guiding the workflow. Imports raw multi-vendor measurement files (BioLogic, Gamry, Ivium, Scribner, EcoChemie, and more) into ZStudio .zstudy documents, and opens, inspects, and saves studies via session handles — with token-light per-dataset summaries (no raw spectra), for AI assistants over MCP.
